text:
anya: Heads-up: after the 00:30 canary we saw a spike in partial streaming responses followed by client retries, increasing gateway CPU and duplicate tokens.

matt: Saw that too. repro with curl + chunked: request returns first chunk then connection drops, client retries -> two in-flight fragments.

rafael: Any client-visible signal? Are they hitting HTTP 5xx or connection resets?

anya: Mostly `RST` and `504 on retry` from upstream. Client-level logs show they retry after no final trailer within ~2s.

lin: What's current semantics for 'finality'? We only send trailers when KV cache commit finishes; that can be delayed under load.

matt: Ideas: 1) send an early 'progress' trailer 2) surface an explicit resume token per fragment 3) require idempotency key to dedupe across retries.

anya: Tradeoffs: resume tokens add state on gateway (map token -> stream pos). Memory blowup if many partials. Dedupe via idempotency key cheaper but needs request-side coordination.

rafael: Could we offload tokens into Redis with TTL? TTL = 30s probably enough. That lets edge remain mostly stateless but adds a network hop and tail latency.

lin: Another angle: make client backoff smarter. We could expose an `X-Estimated-Final` header with a p50/p95 estimate so clients wait before retrying.

matt: Exposing estimates leaks internal perf but is useful. Could be opt-in via `Prefer: resume=1` header to avoid global exposure.

anya: Proposal (minimal surface): add `X-Resume-Token` on the last chunk and a trailer `stream-final=true` when done. For retries client includes token as `Resume-Token` header and gateway rejects if token expired.

matt: Example client flow:
```
GET /v1/chat/stream HTTP/1.1
Prefer: resume=1
Idempotency-Key: <uuid>

# if retry:
GET /v1/chat/stream HTTP/1.1
Resume-Token: <token>
Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
```

rafael: We also need canonical behavior when a retry races with a late final commit — dedupe idempotently if tokens match, otherwise let second pass be served but throttle to avoid double-cost.

lin: Sync with billing: partial tokens already billed? If we accept resume we must avoid double billing. Maybe mark resumed requests as continuation (bill only delta tokens consumed). That needs billing-side signals.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary 2026-03-18T00:30Z triggered alert #3247 (downstream-backpressure)

sre-bot: alert: increased 5xx rate on /v1/chat streams, threshold breach during canary window

anya: Action items: 1) spec resume-token lifecycle (TTL, storage backend, size limit) 2) add opt-in header `Prefer: resume=1` 3) client library support to honor `X-Estimated-Final` when present 4) PoC Redis-backed token store + metrics.

matt: I'll draft an RFC with state machine, error cases, and sample HTTP snippets. Will include perf projections for token retention and memory pressure.

rafael: Ping me for cost/billing language. Also add metrics: `resume_attempts`, `resume_success`, `token_expiry_rate`, and `partial_response_billed`.

lin: We should also document fallback: if resume not enabled, gateway should prefer early-abort and a clear 5xx with `Retry-After` instead of silent drops.

anya: Thanks — putting up RFC PR for review by EOD. /cc @lin @rafael @matt
